subject.title: Dashboard: new data-binding kinds — stream, command, computed

question: Should dashboard data bindings include an allowlisted periodic command-execution source, or should command execution be split into a separate security-reviewed design after stream and computed bindings?
rationale: Automation cannot choose the operator permission and command-execution boundary, and the dashboard substrate this extends has not landed on current main.

options.title: Split Command Design
options.body: Proceed with stream and computed binding design only after the substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved command-binding proposal.

options.title: Approve All Three Kinds
options.body: Accept stream, computed, and command bindings as one roadmap feature with full allowlist, permission, and proof requirements.

options.title: Pause Apps-Layer Work
options.body: Keep the item open but defer implementation until maintainers decide whether this dashboard apps layer belongs in bundled OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Split Command Design
recommendation.body: Proceed with stream and computed binding design only after the substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved command-binding proposal.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is the recently merged Control UI plugin-tab seam that this roadmap builds on.
